items.title: 3 big reasons why Black Friday will probably exceed retailer expectations
items.summary:
The Super Bowl for shopping and everything discounts and deals is upon us once again: Black Friday. 

Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi examines why this year's Black Friday could be a huge event for retailers as US consumers prepare to spend big for the holidays.

items.title: Amazon Has 59 Buy Ratings and Not a Single Sell. Here’s Where its Headed
items.summary: Wall Street analysts agree on Amazon, yet the stock keeps stalling while AWS accelerates. A $220 billion spending plan and negative free cash flow could decide whether the cloud giant rewards patient investors or tests their nerve.

items.title: BJ’s joins Costco, Sam’s Club in Thanksgiving Day store closings
items.summary: The warehouse retailer confirmed its holiday schedule to TheStreet, including extended shopping hours for Black Friday and the days before Christmas.

items.title: Meta Platforms Just Partnered With Walmart. Here's Why Investors Should Pay Attention
items.summary: Meta landing Walmart as a shopping partner may signal that the tech leader's AI spending could eventually pay off.

items.title: Walmart, Amazon Face Surprising Shopping Shift
items.summary: A familiar holiday tradition is exposing deeper economic pressures.

items.title: CVS is open on Thanksgiving, but customers should check one important detail
items.summary: The pharmacy chain confirmed its holiday plans to TheStreet as Walmart, Target and other major retailers remain closed.

items.title: General Motors Is Up 11% in a Month as the Nasdaq-100 Fell 10%. Is Its Nasdaq Switch Really That Good?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysGeneral Motors stock is up 11% in the past month, mostly on its move to Nasdaq, while the Nasdaq-100 fell 10%. Ford’s higher profit floor and a shift out of Tesla helped too, but Ford expects flat 2027 profit.

items.title: McDonald’s, Dunkin’ restaurants are open on Thanksgiving with a twist
items.summary: Many fast-food restaurants and coffee shops will open on Thanksgiving, but customers shouldn’t count on regular hours.
